concepts.definition: A jurisdiction-specific target for a periodic patent renewal fee.
concepts.scopeNote: National-phase jurisdiction and applicable national law are required; no US annual-fee inference.

concepts.definition: A target for initiating or progressing an appeal in a patent matter.
concepts.scopeNote: 37 CFR 41.31; the particular appeal action is recorded by the consumer.

concepts.definition: A target for filing a continuing patent application while the relevant benefit conditions remain available.
concepts.scopeNote: 35 USC 120; 37 CFR 1.78; no pendency calculation.

concepts.definition: A docket target for an action associated with a matter, authority and supporting evidence.
concepts.scopeNote: Authority periods are contextual; no date is calculated.

concepts.definition: A recorded status of a docket target, supported by a consumer-owned observation.
concepts.scopeNote: Repository status vocabulary; no legal conclusion is derived. Status descriptors may overlap; no exclusive state partition is asserted.

concepts.definition: An observed occurrence supporting creation, revision or satisfaction of a docket target.
concepts.scopeNote: An occurrence differs from a planned deadline.

concepts.definition: A recorded target whose authority or evidence supports an extension.
concepts.scopeNote: Extension evidence is required; the vocabulary itself grants no extension. Status descriptors may overlap; no exclusive state partition is asserted.

concepts.definition: A recorded target identified by supporting evidence as the final applicable target.
concepts.scopeNote: Deadline finality differs from a final office action; neither is inferred from this label. Status descriptors may overlap; no exclusive state partition is asserted.

concepts.definition: A target for submitting an information disclosure statement in patent prosecution.
concepts.scopeNote: 37 CFR 1.97 and 1.98; timing depends on prosecution context.

concepts.definition: A target for paying a fee required to maintain an eligible patent.
A recorded target whose supporting observation reports that the action was not timely completed.
concepts.scopeNote: The consumer owns the observation, date and any remedial analysis. Status descriptors may overlap; no exclusive state partition is asserted.

concepts.definition: A target for completing national-stage entry requirements for an international application.
concepts.scopeNote: 35 USC 371; jurisdiction and applicable requirements must be pinned.

concepts.definition: A target for responding to an office action in patent prosecution.
A recorded target awaiting its specified action, whether mandatory or elective.
concepts.scopeNote: Repository state label; does not establish remaining time. Status descriptors may overlap; no exclusive state partition is asserted.

concepts.definition: A target for opposing publication of a trademark application or requesting an applicable extension.
concepts.scopeNote: 15 USC 1063; no opposition-period arithmetic.

concepts.definition: A target for requesting continued examination in a pending patent matter.
concepts.scopeNote: 37 CFR 1.114; context determines whether and when an RCE is appropriate.

concepts.definition: A chosen docket target for an elective declaration of incontestability when eligibility conditions apply.
concepts.scopeNote: 15 USC 1065; not a universally mandatory statutory filing deadline.

concepts.definition: A target for a declaration of use or excusable nonuse to maintain a trademark registration.
concepts.scopeNote: 15 USC 1058; distinct from renewal and incontestability.

concepts.definition: A target for an application to renew a trademark registration.
concepts.scopeNote: 15 USC 1059; combined filings do not merge the obligation types.

concepts.definition: An internal planning target chosen before an applicable external due date.
concepts.scopeNote: Repository planning concept; not a statutory obligation.

concepts.definition: A target for submitting a statement of use for an intent-to-use trademark application.
A docket target anchored in an applicable statute or rule.
concepts.scopeNote: 35 USC 133 and applicable procedural rules; jurisdiction must be supplied.

concepts.definition: A docket target for a trademark application filing or application-stage requirement.
concepts.scopeNote: A specific filing basis and authority are required; no universal application deadline is asserted.

concepts.definition: A target for responding to an office action in trademark examination.
concepts.scopeNote: 37 CFR 2.62; the issued action and application basis determine the period.

concepts.definition: A jurisdiction-specific target for renewing a trademark registration.
concepts.scopeNote: US renewal is under 15 USC 1059; other jurisdictions require their own authority.
